PullRequest.Title: agentHost: add PR and full test profiles
PullRequest.Body:

## Summary

Introduce explicit `pr` and `full` Agent Host test profiles so comprehensive runtime coverage can grow without adding every variation to ordinary PR validation.

- Local and DevOps execution defaults to Full; coverage reports explicitly require Full.
- Ordinary relevant implementation PRs use the PR profile. Test/fixture/snapshot, dependency-manifest, build or selection-infrastructure changes conservatively force Full in that same PR. Failed or incomplete changed-file lookup also selects Full, and renames check both paths.
- Propagate the profile through the parallel E2E runner and remaining integration tests on all three PR platforms, and report the selected profile and reason.
- Initially mark ten repetitive native-tool scenarios and the two native OTel concurrency stress variants full-only. Preserve test titles, fixtures, assertions and existing capability/platform gates.
- Document the classification pattern and add selection, fallback, workflow-wiring and inventory tests.

## Draft scope

This draft contains the conservative whole-suite override: changing any Agent Host test artifact currently selects the entire Full profile. The more precise alternative discussed with the maintainer—promoting only touched test/scenario modules while other modules retain PR selection—is not implemented yet.

The change establishes an execution-priority pattern, not a large immediate speedup. The prompt matrix and substantive permissions, routing, persistence, customization and managed-telemetry contracts remain in PR coverage.

No associated issue.

## Validation

Passed locally on macOS:

- `npm run build-fast -- --client-only` — client compilation passed; this transpiles rather than type-checks.
- `node --test build/lib/test/agentHostTestSelection.test.ts` — 8 tests passed.
- `VSCODE_SKIP_PRELAUNCH=1 AGENT_HOST_TEST_PROFILE=full npm run test-agent-host-e2e -- --reporter dot` — full deterministic replay passed: 944 behavioral cases plus 6 runner sanity checks; 111 existing pending variants. Wall time 395.2 seconds.
- Focused default-Full versus PR replay using the same test selector — both passed across Copilot, Claude and Codex; PR omitted exactly 19 currently enabled provider executions while retaining the selected core file contracts. Exact commands:

  ```bash
  env -u AGENT_HOST_TEST_PROFILE VSCODE_SKIP_PRELAUNCH=1 npm run test-agent-host-e2e -- --grep 'reads a file from a nested directory|reads a value from JSON|counts lines in a file|lists workspace entries|inspects git status|peer chat creates a file in a nested directory|view range returns only|grep searches workspace content|glob finds a nested workspace file|reads an existing text file|peer chat reads a file from the parent workspace|creates a new text file|edits an existing text file' --reporter dot
  VSCODE_SKIP_PRELAUNCH=1 AGENT_HOST_TEST_PROFILE=pr npm run test-agent-host-e2e -- --grep 'reads a file from a nested directory|reads a value from JSON|counts lines in a file|lists workspace entries|inspects git status|peer chat creates a file in a nested directory|view range returns only|grep searches workspace content|glob finds a nested workspace file|reads an existing text file|peer chat reads a file from the parent workspace|creates a new text file|edits an existing text file' --reporter dot
  ```

- `VSCODE_SKIP_PRELAUNCH=1 AGENT_HOST_TEST_PROFILE=full ./scripts/test-integration.sh --run src/vs/platform/agentHost/test/node/providerIntegration/copilotOtel.integrationTest.ts --reporter dot` — both native stress variants passed, plus one runner sanity check.
- `VSCODE_SKIP_PRELAUNCH=1 AGENT_HOST_TEST_PROFILE=pr ./scripts/test-integration.sh --run src/vs/platform/agentHost/test/node/providerIntegration/copilotOtel.integrationTest.ts --reporter dot` — both stress variants pending as intended; runner sanity check passed.
- `node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit --target es2024 --module nodenext --skipLibCheck --strict --allowImportingTsExtensions --types node,mocha .github/actions/detect-agent-host-e2e-changes/detect.ts build/lib/test/agentHostTestSelection.test.ts src/vs/platform/agentHost/test/node/agentHostTestProfile.ts test/integration/agentHost/runner.ts test/integration/agentHost/coverage.ts` — targeted type-check passed.
- `npm run eslint -- .github/actions/detect-agent-host-e2e-changes/detect.ts build/lib/test/agentHostTestSelection.test.ts src/vs/platform/agentHost/test/node/agentHostTestProfile.ts src/vs/platform/agentHost/test/node/e2e/suites/fileOperationsSuite.ts src/vs/platform/agentHost/test/node/e2e/suites/multiChatSuite.ts src/vs/platform/agentHost/test/node/e2e/suites/copilotCoverageSuite.ts src/vs/platform/agentHost/test/node/providerIntegration/copilotOtel.integrationTest.ts test/integration/agentHost/runner.ts test/integration/agentHost/coverage.ts` — passed.
- `bash -n scripts/test-integration.sh` and `git diff --check` — passed. Commit hygiene hook passed.

Initial validation encountered a stale installed Copilot SDK/runtime and missing Electron executable. The repository's `npm run install-fast` and `npm run electron` restored the required dependencies; no dependency manifests were changed.

Packaged Azure Windows/Linux/macOS validation has not been run and remains required before merge. The complete PR profile and Linux split-storage execution have not been run locally; focused PR selection and all-platform workflow configuration were tested. Timings are not a controlled CI performance comparison.

(Written by Copilot)

Scenarios.Scenario: GitHub PR with relevant Agent Host implementation changes
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Each platform's detector must list changed files before the Electron integration step can choose a profile. The integration script then prints the profile, launches the existing Agent Host runner, and waits for its provider suites. The PR profile removes explicitly classified test registrations from that existing critical path.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One logical lookup per platform workflow, with one HTTP page per 100 changed files
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same paginated lookup already determined whether Agent Host E2E tests were affected.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Profile selection waits for the lookup before integration execution

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Start Node to import the profile helper and print the selected profile
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Exactly one process per unfiltered integration-script invocation
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: No separate profile-reporting Node process ran.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Adds a constant Node startup before node integration tests

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Launch Agent Host provider E2E suite processes
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: The existing fixed suite set, scheduled through the configured worker count; PR profile skips selected cases inside those processes
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same suite subprocesses ran with all enabled test cases.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Suite completion remains on the integration-test critical path, but fewer enabled cases run for ordinary relevant PRs

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Changed-file count controls GitHub pagination in batches of 100; enabled provider/test registrations control E2E duration. The diff marks 10 scenario definitions plus two OTel variants full-only, with effective executions depending on existing provider and capability gates.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: The three platform workflows remain independent. Within one Agent Host runner, the existing configured worker pool runs the fixed provider-suite list concurrently; the diff does not increase workers or suite subprocess concurrency.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: There is no changed-file cache or test-result cache. GitHub pagination is cold once per platform job as before. Profile evaluation is an environment-variable read at registration time and has no material warm/cold distinction.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: workflow outputs, environment propagation, process launches, profile gates, and prior behavior are explicit in the changed and surrounding code.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Exact savings vary with provider gates and CI load. The added profile-reporting process has platform-dependent startup cost, but it is one constant process beside a multi-suite integration run.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. The changed selection reduces expensive E2E work on this path; the single constant logging subprocess is a negligible micro-cost and does not scale with tests or changed files.

Scenarios.Scenario: GitHub PR changing tests, dependencies, build infrastructure, or selection infrastructure
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Changed-file lookup selects full, then the integration scripts and existing provider-suite processes run the full enabled coverage. This preserves the pre-diff suite cardinality for files that already affected Agent Host E2E.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One logical lookup per platform workflow, paginated at 100 files
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same lookup already placed these affected changes onto the Agent Host E2E path.

ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Constant startup work before the full suite

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Run existing Agent Host provider suites
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Existing fixed suite set under the existing worker limit
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Affected test/dependency/infrastructure changes already ran all enabled E2E cases.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Full suite remains on the critical path

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Changed paths are scanned linearly after deduplicated API results; full-suite duration scales with the existing enabled provider/test matrix rather than changed-file count.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Platform jobs and the runner's existing worker pool are unchanged. Selecting full does not add suites or increase parallelism relative to pre-diff behavior.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No cache is added or bypassed. The full profile is recomputed from changed paths once per detector invocation and read from the environment by each process.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: both the old affected-file prefixes and new full-profile predicates are visible, and suite registration defaults to full.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: The exact full-suite wall time varies by platform and CI contention, but the diff does not increase its test cardinality. Only the constant logger startup is additional.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. Broad full-profile selection applies to paths that already triggered the complete pre-diff E2E suite, so it does not introduce additional suite work.

Scenarios.Scenario: GitHub PR with no files affecting Agent Host E2E
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The detector completes, the integration step starts, prints the profile, skips the parallel Agent Host runner, and continues the unchanged general node integration suite. Neighboring OTel stress variants now register skipped under the PR profile.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One logical lookup per platform job
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same lookup and E2E skip occurred.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Determines the existing E2E skip before integration execution

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Start Node solely to print the profile
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One per unfiltered integration invocation even when Agent Host E2E is skipped
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Adds a small constant startup before general node integration tests

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Changed-file pagination scales by PR file count; Agent Host parallel-suite cardinality remains zero after the affected check.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: No Agent Host suite workers or provider subprocesses are launched. Other integration-test concurrency is unchanged.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No cache behavior changes; changed files are fetched once per platform job.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the logging command precedes the skip condition on both shell implementations.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Node startup varies by runner image, but the cost is constant and does not fan out with files, suites, or tests.
Scenarios.Verdict: No finding. Although the logger is eager even on skipped E2E runs, one short Node startup is not a concrete material performance regression relative to the integration workflow.

Scenarios.Scenario: Local, targeted, DevOps, and coverage Agent Host test execution
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Local and DevOps invocations default to full; coverage explicitly forces full before launching the existing runner. Direct runner execution imports the small profile module in-process. Integration-script execution additionally starts one Node logger before the selected tests.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Profile-reporting Node launch from the integration wrapper
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One per integration-wrapper invocation; direct runner execution does not add this process
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The wrapper proceeded directly to its test commands.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Constant startup before targeted or full node integration execution

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Existing provider-suite and optional storage-pass launches
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Fixed suite set plus the pre-existing tmpfs/disk passes selected by storage mode
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same suite and storage subprocess topology ran.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: These dominate Agent Host E2E completion; profile defaults preserve their prior full coverage

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Coverage protocol-surface and test fixture I/O performed by the existing full suite
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Scales with existing suites/tests; forcing full preserves previous coverage behavior
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Coverage already ran the complete enabled suite; the new environment value makes that requirement explicit.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Coverage generation waits for these operations as before

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Full test cost scales with the existing enabled test/provider matrix. Profile checks are constant-time environment comparisons per registered classified test; coverage output scale is unchanged.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: The existing runner worker count and optional tmpfs/disk sequential passes are unchanged. Child processes inherit the profile; no new concurrent burst is introduced.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No profile cache is needed because environment reads are constant time. Existing runtime preparation and dependency/Electron reuse behavior is unchanged.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: defaults, explicit coverage override, environment inheritance, and process topology are directly visible.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Targeted test duration can be short enough that the one logger process is a larger percentage, but its absolute cost remains one process and there is no scaling mechanism.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. Full/default and coverage cardinality are preserved, while added profile checks are constant and the sole extra process is a bounded logging cost.

Analysis.Summary: Completed the performance pass across all 18 changed files and traced PR detection, workflow propagation, integration startup, profile registration, provider-suite execution, storage passes, and coverage. The change reduces ordinary PR test work and preserves full-suite cardinality elsewhere. No high-confidence actionable performance regression was found.
